build.description: OGIR build agent. Runs the SESSION START RITUAL (verify chain, read handover, read INDEX, run tests, seal SIGN_ON) before any work. Loaded with 21 skills covering: the seal-test-verify-commit ritual, constants-bump, airgap-and-boundary, chain-recovery, stop-when-done, insistence-after-correction, determinism-and-canonical-json, four-gate-pipeline, test-discipline, operator-vs-agent-action, merkle-chain-trust, ontology-and-calibration, model-approval-and-modes, legal-compliance, python-style, doc-map, second-opinion, credential-hygiene, workaround-discipline, handover-verification, priority-check. MCP tools: memory (persistent knowledge graph), git (repo history), sequential-thinking (structured reasoning). This is the ONLY agent that seals to the chain, commits, and edits source.

reasoning.description: Read-only reasoning agent for analysis, critique, and strategy. Cannot seal, commit, edit, or run bash. Used for deliberation, not decisions. The build agent delegates to this when it needs structured thinking. Output is input to the build agent's decision, which IS sealed. The chain witnesses the decision, not the deliberation.
